title: Home practical guide and safety card: insulation cups
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: Reactivity (9F); energy transfer by heating
source: Written for science/y9 lesson 40 (Home practical guide and safety card: insulation cups (portal worksheet; adult pours, cups on a tray))
intro: Lesson 40: Home insulation investigation. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To find out which material insulates best
equipment: Materials: foil, a woolly sock, bubble wrap, nothing
safety: Adult pours, cups on a tray
An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Wrap three cups in a different material; leave one bare
An adult pours the same amount of warm water into each
Record the temperature every 5 minutes for 20 minutes
Work out the drop for each cup
The smallest drop is the best insulator

questions.q: Materials that trap air are good...
Big question: which wrap keeps a drink hottest, and why?
questions.a: Usually a towel or bubble wrap, because they trap air.
